groups.saying_opens: أن أبا بكر، وعمر، وابن، عمر كانوا ينزلون الأبطح

notes: Saying 1 (the Companions' practice at al-Abtah) is relayed by سالم, the last link; ابن عمر in «وابن، عمر» is a Companion whose act is described, not a link.
«قال الزهري وأخبرني عروة، عن عائشة» opens a second saying with its own isnad; its group keeps the shared head up to الزهري, as in worked example 5.
The archive flag (a further transmitter after the last stored name) does not apply to this reading: each saying ends at its own last link.
